questions: Which archived TOBI.DAT/TOBIA.DAT file actually supports each science-log anchor, including 06:31 UTC?
At 00:15, is the large V2 residual dominated by disagreement between archived cd169.nav ship position and the ship position written in the science log?

At 05:30, does ship navigation remain consistent while raw TOBI heading/reciprocal-layback direction disagrees with the logged ship-to-TOBI vector, consistent with a turn/inertial/catenary diagnostic case?

frozen_inputs.science_log_source: official CD169 cruise report TOBI science log line 19
frozen_inputs.v2_model: external cable + 200 m, raw pressure vertical term, reciprocal raw TOBI gyro heading; no fitted parameters

diagnostic_outputs: actual raw file and nearest raw ping timestamp for every science-log anchor
external cd169.nav ship position versus science-log ship position residual
raw TOBI gyro heading and reciprocal bearing
V2 reconstructed vehicle residual to logged TOBI position

descriptive_tags.SHIP_NAV_SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT_CANDIDATE: external ship nav vs science-log ship residual >= 1000 m
descriptive_tags.HEADING_OR_TOW_DYNAMICS_CANDIDATE: ship-source residual <= 250 m AND reciprocal-heading vs logged tow-vector bearing mismatch >= 20 deg
descriptive_tags.RAW_TIME_SUPPORT_GOOD: nearest real raw ping within 10 s of anchor
descriptive_tags.RAW_TIME_SUPPORT_BOUNDARY: nearest real raw ping more than 60 s from anchor

interpretation_boundary: Tags are diagnostics selected after prior residual inspection and therefore may explain mechanisms but may not be used as a blinded model-validation pass.
